name: Party Identification Information
definition: Unique and unambiguous way to identify a party

TaxIdentificationNumber.name: Tax Identification Number
TaxIdentificationNumber.definition: Number assigned by a tax authority to an entity.

NationalRegistrationNumber.name: National Registration Number
NationalRegistrationNumber.definition: Number assigned by a national registration authority to an entity. In Singapore this is known as the NRIC.

TypeOfIdentification.name: Type Of Identification
TypeOfIdentification.definition: Specifies the type of alternate identification which can be used to identify a party.

Declaration.name: Declaration
Declaration.definition: Provides declaration details relative to the party.

PartyType.name: Party Type
PartyType.definition: Specifies the type of party in different business contexts.

RegistrationAuthorityIdentification.name: Registration Authority Identification
RegistrationAuthorityIdentification.definition: An identifier for the Legal Entity in a business registry in the jurisdiction of legal registration, or in the appropriate registration authority.

OtherIdentification.name: Other Identification
OtherIdentification.definition: Identifier issued to a party for which no specific identifier has been defined.

IdentifiedParty.name: Identified Party
IdentifiedParty.definition: Party for which an identification is provided.

PartyName.name: Party Name
PartyName.definition: Name by which a party is known and which is usually used to identify that party.

ValidityPeriod.name: Validity Period
ValidityPeriod.definition: Specifies the period during which an identification is valid

IdentifiedMarket.name: Identified Market
IdentifiedMarket.definition: Market for which an identification is provided.

RelatedApprovedBenchmark.name: Related Approved Benchmark
RelatedApprovedBenchmark.definition: Benchmark that is supervised by the endorsing party.

RelatedAdministratedBenchmark.name: Related Administrated Benchmark
RelatedAdministratedBenchmark.definition: Benchmark that is administrated by the administrator party.

RelatedAccountVerification.name: Related Account Verification
RelatedAccountVerification.definition: Unique and unambiguous way to identify a party
